reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing isSkippedByMonthWideAction and getMonthWideCategories helpers that every month-wide action already uses, so the #fixed, template and income exclusions keep coming from their existing definitions.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes once inside isSkippedByMonthWideAction; the six actions only add the same optional parameter and pass it on.

placement.why: The change lives in server/budget/actions.ts in the shared month-wide selection helpers, and the handler types pick the new argument up via typeof actions.*.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing through the month-wide actions, an updated comment and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single defaulted boolean on the shared predicate is easy to follow and keeps the default path identical.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) go through isSkippedByMonthWideAction/getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the repeated per-action parameter declarations are plumbing.
